workflow.contradiction.okWithReview: Your OK before merging is already part of review by you.

workflow.form.pastePlatform: These options are for another version control.
workflow.form.platformDesc: Found in the project folder. The options below are this version control’s.

workflow.notOffered.hiveMerges: “Hive merges” isn’t available in this version yet: choose “The agent merges, Hive checks”.
workflow.notOffered.later: Some of these options aren’t available in this version yet: leave them as they are.
workflow.option.commands.desc: The command each named check runs. A run counts as the check only when it runs that command.
workflow.option.commands.title: Check commands
workflow.option.dependenciesDone.desc: A card that waits for others can’t start before their work is in.
workflow.option.dependenciesDone.none: Cards start only when the cards they wait for are done
workflow.option.dependenciesDone.title: Cards start only when the cards they wait for are merged
workflow.option.excluded.desc: The whole project folder, apart from these folders and files (.hive always).
workflow.option.excluded.title: What the work is
workflow.option.finish.desc: When a card is done: once its agent has merged it and Hive finds the work in the target branch, once it is committed, or whenever it is moved there.
workflow.option.finish.title: Who merges
workflow.option.folder.desc: In its own folder, a card is built in its builder’s worktree, apart from other agents’ work. In the project folder, everyone sees each other’s unfinished changes.
workflow.option.folder.title: Where cards are built
workflow.option.identity.desc: Commits are made with the name and email from the project’s git config (else your global one).
workflow.option.identity.title: Commits use the project’s identity
workflow.option.noSelfReview.desc: Always on while a reviewer agent checks the work.
workflow.option.noSelfReview.title: Nobody reviews their own work
workflow.option.okBefore.desc: A card waits for your OK before it is merged: never, only cards with these labels, or every card.
workflow.option.okBefore.title: Your OK before merging
workflow.option.preChecks.desc: Each check is a named command. A card goes to review only once each one has passed on its work.
workflow.option.preChecks.title: Checks pass before review
workflow.option.review.desc: A card goes to Review when its builder submits it, and on once it passes. With you as well, it waits for your OK after the reviewer.
workflow.option.review.none: Who checks the work before it’s done
workflow.option.review.title: Work is reviewed before it’s merged
workflow.option.reviewers.desc: With two, both must pass the same change.
workflow.option.reviewers.title: Reviewers per card
workflow.option.sameness.desc: With the same change, a pass still counts after the work is moved onto newer commits without changing it.
workflow.option.sameness.title: A pass survives a clean rebase
workflow.option.sharedFolderWarning.desc: In the project folder, a submit warns when its commit takes in files another agent is editing. It never refuses.
workflow.option.sharedFolderWarning.titl: Warn when a commit includes another agent’s files
workflow.option.stopOwnRuns.desc: A card goes to review only once its builder’s own runs and background commands have stopped.
workflow.option.stopOwnRuns.title: Agents stop what they started before review
workflow.option.style.desc: How a card’s work is merged into the target branch.
workflow.option.style.title: Merge style
workflow.option.target.desc: The target branch. Left empty, the repository’s default branch.
workflow.option.target.title: Work merges into
